mapper.insert: insert into task_attachment(student_task_id, request_key, original_name, content_type, size_bytes, sha256, file_bytes) values (#{studentTaskId}, #{requestKey}, #{originalName}, #{contentType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{sha256}, #{fileBytes})

mapper.select: select id from task_attachment where submission_id = #{submissionId} order by id
mapper.delete: delete from task_attachment where id = #{id} and submission_id is null
